text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And living up to all expectations! In 1st 
place, Fusaichi Pandoraaa!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOO...!!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Yaaay, all right♡

text_block_list.name: Pandora's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Awesome! Fusaichi Pandora really is the 
best!

text_block_list.name: Pandora's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Pandora! For your next Queen Elizabeth II 
Cup, I'll come all the way to Kyoto to 
cheer for you!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Whaa...♡ Everyone! Thank you, thank you so 
much!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I wuuuv Sapporo so much~♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Uwoooo~~ah!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Fusaichi Pandora pulled off a 
brilliant result in the Sapporo Kinen as 
well!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: So yummy♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
—Wait! Did you see the reactions on social 
media?! Everyone's praising me like crazy!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"I was worried when I heard about the flu, 
but I'm so glad I got to see such a great 
win~!" "She took down tough opponents fair 
and square!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"The Tiara Umamusume Scarlet and Vodka 
were influenced by her too, weren't they?"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Huh!? For real!? Holy crap!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
""I mean, going for back-to-back Queen 
Elizabeth II Cup wins is way too hype, 
isn't it? That's straight-up the queen of 
a new era!""

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ehe, ehehehe! Ehehehehe♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, Trainer. If I keep working hard 
like this—"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Even someone like me can lead by example, 
right?"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Ehe, right~?♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, I believe our track record 
is already more than sufficient to prove 
our worth."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From Fusaichi Pandora's perspective, I 
wonder if it's still far from enough.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Alright. Once we're back, let's hit the 
training hard!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
“—Whoa, wait up, Trainer! I want that 
one—!”

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
That mascot character! It's way too cute! 
Hey, let's get matching ones!♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The big stage awaiting in November: the 
"Queen Elizabeth II Cup." I want to sprint 
ahead with everything I've got so she can 
shine brighter than anyone!
